one_liner: Manage Google Ads campaigns, accounts and reporting via API.
auth_note: OAuth2 (user or service account) tied to a Google Cloud project; developer tokens sunset Sept 9, 2026, access now granted per Cloud project.
access_note: Sign up in Google Cloud Console; Explorer/Basic auto-reviewed after brand verification; Standard needs manual review (~10 business days). Explorer limited to 2,880 prod ops/day.
api_note: Google Ads API (gRPC/REST) covers campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, budgets, reporting (GAQL).
blocker_note: Production use needs Cloud-project access level (Explorer/Basic automated; Standard manual review) plus brand verification.

evidence.quote: Your API access levels are determined by the Google Cloud project you used to generate your OAuth credentials.
For new Basic and Standard access applications, you must complete brand verification for your Google Cloud project.
Standard | Test and production accounts | Unlimited operations / day
Google Ads MCP server: Developer integration guide
You no longer need a Google Ads manager account to use the Google Ads API.

one_liner: Create and manage Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns and insights via Marketing API.
auth_note: Facebook Login OAuth with ads_read/ads_management permissions; system user tokens for business use.
access_note: Self-serve app creation gives Limited access tier (dev only, heavily rate-limited); Full tier and advanced permissions for others' ad accounts need App Review and business verification.
api_note: Graph-based Marketing API: ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights, audiences, catalogs.
mcp_note: Official Meta Ads MCP server / Ads AI connectors documented on developers.facebook.com (ads-mcp-server-overview).
blocker_note: Advanced access to ads_management/ads_read for other people's accounts requires App Review; Full tier needs 500 calls/15 days and <15% errors.

evidence.quote: use the scope parameter to prompt them for the ads_management or ads_read permissions
Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.
Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.
Ads MCP Server | Meta for Developers
If you're managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access to the ads_read and/or ads_management permissions.

one_liner: Manage LinkedIn ad accounts, campaigns, creatives and reporting via Advertising API.
auth_note: 3-legged OAuth only; 2-legged client credentials not available for marketing use cases.
access_note: Create app, apply for Advertising API product with access form; Development tier (5 ad accounts) after approval, Standard tier needs further review with demo.
api_note: Versioned Marketing APIs: ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, conversions, reporting, lead gen forms, organizations/posts.
mcp_note: No first-party LinkedIn Ads MCP found in vendor docs; third-party only.
blocker_note: Advertising API product requires LinkedIn review of use case before credentials work; Standard tier needs second review.

evidence.quote: The 2-legged client credentials flow is not available for any marketing use cases.
Visit your app's Product tab in the Developer Portal to apply for the Advertising API.
Add up to 5 accounts to manage in the Development Tier.

one_liner: Email marketing platform with audiences, campaigns and automation.
auth_note: API key or OAuth2 token, sent via HTTP Basic or Bearer; OAuth2 for multi-user apps.
access_note: Free Mailchimp account lets you generate API keys; OAuth app registration is self-serve. Free plan feature limits apply.
api_note: Marketing API v3 at api.mailchimp.com/3.0: lists, members, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, ecommerce; Transactional (Mandrill) is separate.

one_liner: Create and manage Pins, boards, ads and catalogs on Pinterest.
auth_note: OAuth 2.0 access tokens required for user authorization; app secret withheld until Standard access.
access_note: Apply for API access to get Trial tier; Standard upgrade needs demo video of OAuth flow and review. Trial restricts writes (e.g. POST /v5/pins) per community reports.
api_note: API v5: pins, boards, user account, ad accounts/campaigns/ads, audiences, catalogs, analytics, sandbox.
mcp_note: Official Pinterest MCP at https://api.pinterest.com/mcp (Bearer token), developers.pinterest.com/about-pinterest-mcp.
blocker_note: Trial access is manual-approval and limited; full functionality requires Standard upgrade with demo review.

evidence.quote: The compliant way for an app to authenticate a user is by obtaining an OAuth access token.
If approved for API use, your app receives Trial access, which is best for exploring our API features.
"url": "https://api.pinterest.com/mcp"
Your app must already be approved for Trial access and comply with our Developer Guidelines.

one_liner: Publish Threads posts, read replies and insights via Threads API.
auth_note: Threads user access tokens (OAuth 2.0): 1-hour short-lived, exchangeable for 60-day long-lived, refreshable.
access_note: Create Meta app with Threads use case; app roles/testers work immediately, other users require App Review per permission and a published app.
api_note: Endpoints for profile, media publishing (text/image/video/carousel), replies, reply management, insights.
mcp_note: No official Threads MCP found on Meta pages.
blocker_note: threads_basic / threads_content_publish / threads_read_replies need App Review for non-tester users.

evidence.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published.
To access the Threads API, create an app and pick the Threads use case.
Threads testers can grant your app these permissions at any time.
